== Description ==

[[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (left) and [[Patrik Csapi]] (right) take a selfie in front of the Players Committee banner at the [[2024 World Championship]] in Bochum.

* '''Shared by:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] (Slack: Scott)
* '''Date:''' 21 September 2024 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]]: moustache and black "IRON EMPIRE" T-shirt, as #32 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]. [[Patrik Csapi]]: long dark hair and full dark beard, as #45 in the group photograph and in [[:File:2024 World Championship players at the banner.jpg]].
